Проверяю позиции на бирже и причину перезапусков.

[COMMAND_FOR_CODE]cd /opt/aila && /opt/aila/venv/bin/python -c "
import asyncio
from aila.trading.bybit_exchange import BybitExchange
async def check():
    ex = BybitExchange()
    positions = await ex.get_positions()
    if positions:
        for p in positions:
            print(f'{p.get(\"symbol\")} | side={p.get(\"side\")} | size={p.get(\"size\")} | pnl={p.get(\"unrealisedPnl\")} | entry={p.get(\"avgPrice\")}')
    else:
        print('NO OPEN POSITIONS')
asyncio.run(check())
"[/COMMAND_FOR_CODE]

[COMMAND_FOR_CODE]sudo journalctl -u aila --since "4 hours ago" | grep -i "started\|stopped\|failed\|error\|traceback\|exception\|crash" | tail -30[/COMMAND_FOR_CODE]

[COMMAND_FOR_CODE]sudo systemctl status aila --no-pager | head -15[/COMMAND_FOR_CODE]
